From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: QBR sprint: executive checkpoints, blocked rollouts, and stakeholder asks

Team —

Following our ops sync this morning, quick weekly pull for the exec distro with three buckets: wins, risks, and asks. This is intended to be terse so leadership can triage. See attached tracker (qbr_backlog_tracker.xlsx) and the QBR kit link below.

Wins
- Hosted API average p95 latency improved by 12% week-over-week after the kernel selection tweak; preliminary cost-run looks positive.
- Dedicated pools: completed GPU packing change for customer beta (Acme Cloud) — throughput steady at target.

Risks
- Rollout blocker: Acme Cloud procurement still needs contract redlines resolved; their legal cited data residency paragraph. If not cleared by 9/19 we risk delaying their Dedicated go-live.
- Model regression: two prompt families show score drift post-quantization on long-seq paths. Needs immediate eval gating before can be promoted to prod.

Asks (Owners & deadlines)
- Laura: prioritize legal push on Acme redlines; can you escalate to Kate in legal and request a final by 9/16? (owner: laura_bennett; due: 2027-09-16)
- Hannah: lead a triage on the quantization regression, short RACI and a mitigation plan by 9/14. Attach any short-term rollback playbook to the tracker. (owner: hannah_schmitt; due: 2027-09-14)
- Karthik: confirm capacity planning for Dedicated burst buffer for Acme (owner: karthik_iyer; due: 2027-09-15)

Notes: I’ve put starter rows in qbr_backlog_tracker.xlsx (attached) and linked the QBR kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qbr-kit. I’ll follow up with a status summary mid-week.

Thanks —
Rishi

Thanks — quick readout on the quantization regression:
- Root cause hypothesis: new kernel path exposes precision edge-case for long sequences; failing tests are 1.2% of prompt set but concentrated on the LLM-internal reranker prompts.
- Immediate mitigation: add prompt-family gating to the rollout (rollback toggle + prefix-caching bypass) — will require a 2-hour maintenance window if toggled.
- Recommended short-term: disable quantized variant for reranker family and trigger a re-eval across full prompt set.

I’ve attached a brief (risk-mitigation-brief.pdf) with the rollback steps and test plan. Will own the 9/14 deliverable and post the triage notes to the tracker.

Attachment: risk-mitigation-brief.pdf (3 pages)

-Hannah

Looping in Samantha so Acme is aware of the decision lane and timeline. Short summary and next steps:
- Legal: Laura to escalate; target 9/15 EOD for redline consolidation.
- Inference: Hannah to deliver triage + rollback plan by 9/14. If we see further regression we will enact the toggle (possible 2-hour window) and notify affected customer teams.
- Capacity: Karthik to confirm Dedicated burst buffer allocation for Acme by 9/15.

Samantha — appreciate your patience. If we close legal and capacity by the deadlines above, we are on track for your go-live target. If not, we’ll share a short mitigation (phased rollout) plan by 9/19.

I’ll run a mid-week status note on Wednesday with quick updates against the tracker.

Thanks all —
Rishi
